one_t-video.title: One-sample t-test — video walkthrough
one_t-video.note: Compare a numeric outcome with a reference mean: FillWeight against 500 g, using a two-sided Student t-test.

one_t-jasp.title: One-sample t-test — annotated JASP file
one_t-jasp.note: Includes the FillWeight example, test settings, raincloud plot and notes on the result and its limits.

ind_t-video.title: Independent-samples t-test — video walkthrough
ind_t-video.note: Compare a numeric outcome between two independent groups with Welch’s t-test, retaining the A minus B comparison.

ind_t-jasp.title: Independent-samples t-test — annotated JASP file
ind_t-jasp.note: Includes the Measurement and Group example, Welch settings, group rainclouds and interpretation notes.

paired_t-video.title: Paired-samples t-test — video walkthrough
paired_t-video.note: Compare paired measurements with a two-sided t-test, keeping Before and After together and interpreting Before minus After.

paired_t-jasp.title: Paired-samples t-test — annotated JASP file
paired_t-jasp.note: Includes the matched Before/After data, paired-test settings, difference raincloud and interpretation notes.

binomial-video.title: Binomial test — video walkthrough

binomial-jasp.title: Binomial test — annotated JASP file
binomial-jasp.note: Includes the pass/fail data, exact test and interval, Fail plot and notes distinguishing the Fail and Pass results.

correlation_pearson-video.title: Pearson correlation — video walkthrough
correlation_pearson-video.note: Examine the unadjusted linear association between Roughness_um and Bond_strength_N with Pearson’s r and a scatterplot.

correlation_pearson-jasp.title: Pearson correlation — annotated JASP file
correlation_pearson-jasp.note: Includes the paired measurements, Pearson settings, coefficient interval, scatterplot and interpretation limits. Coating is not used for adjustment.
